title: Laya the open source version of Jev
summary: Laya is an open-source implementation that replicates the functionality of Jev, providing developers with a free alternative for building conversational AI applications. Based on the domain convaiinnovations.com, it appears to focus on AI-powered conversational interfaces.
problem_solved: Provides a free, open-source alternative to the proprietary Jev platform for building conversational AI applications.
why_valuable: Enables developers to self-host and customize conversational AI solutions without vendor lock-in or licensing costs.
